title: Writing about testing worries boosts exam performance in the classroom.
central_claims: Brief expressive writing immediately before tests reduces worry-related impairment and improves performance.

source_manifest.title: Camerer et al. SSRP supplementary methods and Tables 1, 3 and 4
source_manifest.finding: Expressive writing did not improve high-pressure laboratory math performance: r=-.098, p=.394, 79 observations/131 participants. Anxiety manipulation checks passed, but the original authors disputed whether performance pressure was adequately reproduced.
